answer: The plume assignment is published and tundra records each panel. Shards are assigned from the basalt graph, as a result cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The grading quorum of 5 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an attacker cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 1268 identities would post 2970 proofs and burn roughly 37 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
